basis:
Card carries no tradition/system field; the card gives a mundane-astrology configuration (Jupiter–Saturn–Pluto conjunction, outer planets clustered, cyclical index at century low) and asks about a collective affliction for 2020–2021, decided as Western mundane astrology. No natal chart is involved.
Method: classical/mundane reading of the stated configuration — Saturn–Pluto is the classical signature of mass hardship, plague and structural collapse (comparable clusters listed on the card coincided with 1918, 1954, 1968, 1982, several of them influenza pandemic years); the cyclical index at its 21st-century low marks a collective trough. Card-listed precedent years are facts on the card, used as the analogy base, not imported outcomes.
[Section 8 quantity check] Lines: Saturn–Pluto–Jupiter conjunction exact early 2020 (pressing, strongest, directly on the collective-affliction object); five-outer-planet cluster within ~100 degrees (pressing, concentration); cyclical index at century low (pressing, scale marker); precedent-cluster analogy (supporting). Main line: the Saturn–Pluto conjunction line, acting directly on mass affliction. Band: with two-plus pressing lines and no relieving line on the card, the affliction is graded at the top band — a worldwide, high-mortality event, not a regional or mild episode; no downgrade without a named relieving factor, and none is given.
prediction_text: Main call: YES — the 2020–2021 period holds a major collective affliction of the pandemic kind: a widespread epidemic disease sweeping many countries, with heavy mortality and prolonged social disruption, centred on 2020 (the exact Jupiter–Saturn–Pluto conjunction in early 2020) and extending into 2021. Timing: year-scale window opening at the start of 2020, main coordinate the first half of 2020 for onset/global spread. Scale: worldwide and severe — of the order of the 1918 precedent among the card's comparison years, not a mild seasonal influenza wave. Form: disease-led affliction (plague signature of Saturn–Pluto), accompanied by economic and institutional strain as secondary effects.
